name: Cell Signaling
summary: How cells sense and respond to signals: receptors, second messengers and the core signaling pathways behind development, physiology and disease.

topics.name: Principles of signaling: ligands, receptors, specificity, amplification and adaptation
G-protein-coupled receptors, G proteins and cAMP/PKA
Calcium signaling, IP3/DAG and protein kinase C
Receptor tyrosine kinases and the Ras/MAPK cascade
Developmental pathways: Wnt, Hedgehog and Notch
Nuclear receptors and steroid hormone signaling
Nitric oxide and gaseous signaling molecules
Signal integration, crosstalk, feedback and network behaviour
Signaling in bacteria and plants: two-component systems and plant receptor kinases
